regions.merged_text: Many thanks for your favor of yesterday, just noted. I would be pleased to see you any Saturday or Sunday convenient to you. In case you drive down, a good way is via #112 (and Willowrun), to Coldwater and then, Coldwater 2 - to - via #24 to Jefferson Ave. Huntington: turn up to right 3 - to till St. Felix is seen a half mile off to the left. to Fort Wayne take #27. If it should be muddy and soft, better go back two or three blocks to first paved street. St. Felix is only about one and a half mile from the center of City. In the mean time I am sending you a coppy of a letter which if read prop- erly ought to help you greatly to shake off that excessive worry you seem to be laboring under. That of course you ought to fight against. Because it is never good to worry and in nine cases out ten the worry is about something that has no real foundation, therefore, never happens.
